newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE men jailed, to be lashed for assault on woman.
newsitem.headline: UAE men jailed, to be lashed for assault on woman.

text.p: An Islamic court in the United Arab Emirates sentenced three men to six years in jail and 680 lashes each for assaulting a woman, threatening to kill her and drinking alcohol, newspapers reported on Tuesday.
They said the three-man sharia Islamic law court in the port city of Khorfakkan could not prove a charge of rape -- an offence punishable by death in the UAE.
But it sentenced the three men for adultery, trespass, threatening to kill and consuming alcohol.
Newspapers said earlier that the woman was attacked in her house in Duba al-Husn in the emirate of Sharjah and assaulted in front of her children.
The victim and suspects were all UAE nationals.
